verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an in-session data channel or data-track API for exchanging arbitrary low-latency data alongside audio and video. The only nearby material is in-app text chat and cross-device state sync, which are separate Twilio tools and adjacent features, not the product's own session data API, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, participants exchange low-latency arbitrary data in the session alongside audio and video, with a documented data API
